items.prompt: The additivity identity passes on a small enumerated domain. What has been established?

options.text: It is a proof for all possible real-world fee models
options.why: The property may not even hold for tiered or rounded fees.

options.text: The checked cases satisfy it under this implementation
options.why: Finite cases do not prove the universal mathematical statement.

options.text: Every future implementation must satisfy the same tests
options.why: Future code must be run; this result does not transfer automatically.

options.text: No additional example or invalid-input tests are useful
options.why: Other tests can target different failure modes and domains.

items.explanation: The enumeration supplies evidence for its checked values and implementation. A universal proof or broader fee policy requires separate reasoning.
